items.title: VS Code Remote-SSH RCE Lets Attackers Pivot From Developer Machines to Cloud Servers
items.description: A newly disclosed vulnerability in Visual Studio Code’s Remote-SSH extension exposes a critical post-compromise attack path that allows threat actors to pivot from infected developer machines into cloud and production environments. Given the extension’s widespread adoption across modern development workflows, the issue poses a significant risk to organizations that rely on remote infrastructure…
